# ScalableSpikingNetworkConstruction

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A method for building spiking neural networks using up to a certain scale of resources, focusing on efficient connectivity and resource allocation. Enables practical deployment of large neuromorphic networks in constrained in-network environments, addressing scalability bottlenecks.
